key_insight: A three-stage framework enhances ground-state preparation by efficiently loading matrix product states and reducing residual error through probabilistic imaginary-time evolution.
engineering_relevance: This framework offers a practical hybrid approach to improve fidelity in quantum simulations, essential for advancing quantum algorithms.
method: Utilizes DMRG to obtain a matrix product state for an N-site system.
Employs an optimization-free MPD circuit for efficient encoding onto a quantum register.
Applies probabilistic imaginary-time evolution to reduce residual error after encoding.
evidence_signal: Empirical results indicate that the number of layers needed to achieve target infidelity scales as O(N^5 log(N/ε)).
watch_item: The framework may face challenges with scalability and deep circuit implementation beyond certain system sizes.
paper_title: Overcoming the Matrix-Product-State Encoding Barrier via DMRG-Guided Probabilistic Imaginary-Time Evolution
